name: Navigate main pages and legal information
covers: path navigation and legacy hash compatibility
description: Verifies the main site sections and legal information are reachable through the existing single-page navigation.
steps: Open the site
Choose Services in the main navigation
Choose Fleet & Corporate
Choose Home
Open Privacy notice from the footer
Open Website terms from the footer
expected: Each selected view appears, navigation stays functional, and the privacy and terms content can be reached.

name: Submit a valid private and fleet quote enquiry
description: Verifies private and fleet enquiries are prepared for WhatsApp with the supplied details and consent guardrail.
steps: Open Contact
Complete name, phone, vehicle make and model, service and town or suburb, then check consent
Submit and verify WhatsApp opens with the vehicle details
Return to the form, select Fleet or corporate enquiry and enter a company name and fleet size
Submit again
expected: The standard enquiry opens with vehicle details; the fleet enquiry includes the supplied fleet details in the prefilled WhatsApp message.

name: Prevent incomplete quote enquiries on mobile
description: Verifies the quote form blocks submission when required details or consent are missing on a mobile viewport.
steps: Open Contact on mobile
Leave required fields empty and leave consent unchecked
Tap Review enquiry in WhatsApp
expected: Browser validation identifies missing required information and no WhatsApp enquiry is opened.

name: Open mobile navigation and reach fleet enquiry
description: Verifies mobile navigation exposes the site sections and closes after selecting a destination.
steps: Open the site on mobile
Tap the navigation menu button
Tap Fleet & Corporate
expected: The fleet view appears, the mobile menu closes, and the menu button reports its collapsed state.

name: Use the visual glass guide and product catalogue on mobile
description: Verifies the homepage vehicle glass map and product-style category cards lead into the guided finder while preserving the existing truthful quote flow.
steps: Open the site on mobile
Tap Front windscreen on the vehicle image
Verify Find Glass opens with Front windscreen selected
Return Home and choose Rear glass from the category rail
Verify the rear-glass choice is selected in the finder
Complete make and model, leave year blank, continue through the finder and submit
expected: The homepage hero and supporting photo show relevant auto-glass work; the side-profile vehicle guide places arrows on the corresponding front windscreen, side windows, quarter glass and rear glass; gallery cards display relevant reference imagery with clear wording that stock photos are not verified Infinity jobs; category selections still prefill Find Glass, product cards show relevant glass images or a safe fallback, and the wizard accepts an unknown year without inventing stock, compatibility or prices.

name: Open the dedicated FAQ page and check desktop tablet layout safeguards
description: Verifies the FAQ route is available and page metadata changes with navigation while the site remains responsive at desktop widths.
steps: Open the site at a desktop viewport
Choose FAQs in the main navigation
Verify the FAQ view and page title are updated
Resize to a tablet-width viewport and inspect the hero text and illustration
expected: The FAQ page opens from navigation, the title reflects the FAQ page, and hero content remains readable without the decorative glass artwork covering the main text.
